name: The Grim Captain's Locker
oracle_text:
{T}: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
{T}: Until end of turn, each creature card in your graveyard gains "Escape—{3}{B}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard." (You may cast a card with escape from your graveyard for its escape cost.)
blocked_sentences: {T}: Until end of turn, each creature card in your graveyard gains "Escape—{3}{B}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard."

needs.what: a turn-long grant that gives every creature card in your graveyard (including ones that arrive later this turn) an escape cost fixed by the granting card -- an alternative cost of {3}{B} plus exiling four other cards from your graveyard -- castable from the graveyard, with the escaped condition set on the resulting spell
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_graveyard_cast carries only affects_spells, any_graveyard, grants_flashback and max_per_turn and lets the card be cast for its own printed mana cost, with no way to substitute a granted cost; escape exists only as a card-level graveyard_cost/graveyard_cast on the escaping card itself; grant_playable marks a snapshot of cards and takes playable_cost_reduction/playable_free but no replacement cost with an exile_from_graveyard component; grant_ability grants abilities to permanents, not a card-level cost to cards in a graveyard
